name: Kinocut 2.0.1: the review card works on a plain install
body:
The review card now works on a plain install.

In 2.0.0, `video_review_card` needed Pillow to shrink the contact sheet. Only optional extras install Pillow, so on `pip install kinocut==2.0.0` or `uvx --from kinocut==2.0.0 kino --mcp` a normal cut failed with `No module named 'PIL'`. Kinocut now shrinks the sheet with FFmpeg, which every install already has. (#781)

Also fixed:

- The review card shows the file name instead of its full path. (#755)
- CLI output shows `~` instead of your home directory. (#776)
- The missing-Whisper hint keeps the `[transcribe]` extra in the install command it prints. (#775)

```bash
pip install --upgrade kinocut==2.0.1
claude mcp add kinocut -- uvx --from kinocut==2.0.1 kino --mcp
```

`mcp-video==1.6.22` installs `kinocut==2.0.1` for anyone still on the old name.

What 2.0 changed: [v2.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/KyaniteLabs/kinocut/releases/tag/v2.0.0).
